whyFoster.title: Why Foster?
whyFoster.description: Create space for more rescues and help dogs decompress.
benefits: Save multiple lives by creating space for new rescues
Help dogs decompress and heal from trauma
Experience the joy of nurturing without long-term commitment
Make a direct impact on rescue capacity

responsibilities.title: Foster Responsibilities
responsibilities.description: Provide daily care, safe space, transport to vet visits, and updates.
items: Provide daily care including feeding, exercise, and companionship
Maintain a safe, secure environment for the foster dog
Transport to veterinary appointments and adoption events
Provide regular updates and photos to our team
Help with basic training and socialization
Assist with meet-and-greets with potential adopters
Follow medical care instructions from our veterinary team
Maintain open communication with rescue coordinators

support.title: Support We Provide
support.description: We cover medical costs and provide supplies when available.
items: All medical expenses including emergency care
Food, bowls, leashes, and basic supplies when available
